[h3]Game Introduction:[/h3]
Cavalry Girls is a light roguelike top-down shooter indie game. In this game, players will lead Cavalry Girls into battles against enemy forces. Modify various mecha models, strategically deploy mechas with different skills, repel the overwhelming enemies, and defend your empire amid the raging fires. With limited supplies, players will have to make wise resource allocations, manage soldiers and survive on an increasingly intense battlefield.

[h3]Game Featured[/h3]
[b]
Top-Down Shooting[/b]

- Experience the authentic shooting feel and enjoy the thrilling battlefield.
- A plethora of equipment modules to choose from, with each weapon offering distinct effects.
- Engage in rogue-like combat against dozens of enemy types.

Strategic Deployment[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/82762e0d6f028ec0da94c5d734abab766a52bebb.gif[/img]

notes.title: "Moolii's Dreamland" is officially released!
notes.content:
"Moolii's Dreamland," a 2D hand-drawn side-scrolling bullet hell shooter game, is now officially available on all platforms, including PC, mobile, and Switch! Players can search for "Moolii's Dreamland" on their respective platforms to download the game for free or purchase it.

"Moolii's Dreamland" is published globally by OKJOY and indie developed by WOWOH CAT (one person). The game is inspired by childhood classics like "Salamander" and strives to recreate the classic arcade shoot 'em up gameplay. Players will play as the little fox - Moolii, fighting fierce monsters in a wonderful dream world. There are all sorts of whimsical level designs, different types of monsters, and several powerful bosses in the game. Use your ammunition skills, collect items, accumulate powerful attacks, and eliminate hordes of enemies blocking your way, helping Moolii wake up from the nightmare!

EA players, please delete your save file before playing

notes.title: OKJOY brings diverse gaming to the Chinajoy x Game Connection event!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! OKJOY will participate in the Chinajoy x Game Connection event on July 26th, bringing along our games "HAAK", "Moolii's Dreamland", "The Heroes Around Me", "Taoism", "The Road of Gaokao", and "Avici".

We offer a diverse range of games to meet the needs of all gaming enthusiasts. Whether you're a fan of adventure games, puzzle games, or strategy games, you can find your niche in the games listed below. Now, start with the game descriptions and links below, choose the game you're interested in, and dive into an exciting demo play experience right away!

HAAK：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1352930/HAAK/
Intro： HAAK is a Metroidvania-Platformer. As the mysterious wanderer Haak, you embarked on an epic expedition across the vast cyber-wasteland to find your lost brother. Explore deserted cities and metro, refine your weapons and hack skills, and uncover the secrets behind metal and dust.

Moolii's Dreamland：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280380/Mooliis_Dreamland/
Intro： Help Moolii with her nightmare of the forest! Use claws and bullets and dodge in the roguelike bullet hell where all Moolii's cuttie friends become Mobs and Bosses! Collect and upgrade bullets to help Moolii!

The Heroes Around Me：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1768470/The_Heroes_Around_Me/
Intro： The Heroes Around Me tells a story of a family of 3: the hard-working and quiet father – Nan, his daughter Lili, and their pet dog Sesame. Players will experience the harshness and warmth in the simpler time of the 1990s when lots of stories are untold.

Taoism：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2331080/Taoism/
Intro：Taoism is a roguelike card game inspired by Chinese mythical tales. When evil spirits are all over space, you’ll explore the mysterious country of Luo Nan, use different cards to defeat Taoist priests as well as evil spirits and find the truth of the decline of Luo Nan.

The Road of Gaokao：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1705420/_/
Intro："The Road of Gaokao" is a unique Roguelike card game where you will face a Gaokao countdown of just 100 days. A hundred days of sprinting, a hundred days of change. From study to routine, from diet to exercise, from emotion control to test-taking strategy, meticulously plan and fortify step by step, give it your all, and optimize your preparation plan.

Avici：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2050520/Avici/
Intro：Use the daytime to search for treasures, trade with hermits, and investigate the strange experiences of former expedition members; Or with limited oxygen and lighting equipment, dive deep into the endless darkness of the seabed, escape the threat of unknown creatures, and seek powerful technology.

notes.title: Moolii's Dreamland Demo updated︱17th July 2023
notes.content:
Dear players,

After organizing valuable feedback from all of you, we have made comprehensive optimizations and updates to the game and introduced new elements. The specific contents of this update are as follows:

1. We have added three difficulty levels, namely easy, normal, and hard. In response to feedback from players at different difficulties, we have made corresponding optimizations and adjustments to the game, ensuring each player can have a better gaming experience. After completing levels of different difficulties, icons corresponding to the difficulty level will appear, allowing you to better showcase your achievements.
2. You can customize three sets of virtual button schemes through the settings menu to accommodate different devices and player habits, allowing you to better personalize the game interface. We have also added button feedback effects, so you can feel the response of the buttons more clearly during the game.
3. We have optimized the game's performance and interface design, making the game smoother and more beautiful. We have also fixed some known bugs, improving the stability and playability of the game.

notes.title: The Beginning of a Furry Tail...
notes.content:
On a wind-blowing night, above the trees of the silent forest, only the owl with its big eyes spinning was awake. All the forest animals went to sleep, but some naughty children were still staying up all night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37689288/e3e329547ce1b23ce30d29f73eef1d1850ef18de.png[/img]

[b]That's Little Moolii!![/b]

Living in her forest castle, Moolii is accompanied by her mighty father and beautiful mother. Yet naughty little Moolii, like most kids, likes to watch anime and don't want to sleep early. This angers her mother Curii.

Curii stormed Moolii back to her room, but something happened there...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37689288/eb276d5f16ccd26adf44731a19ed11283a84a23d.png[/img]

In the middle of the night, their cat Dreamy sneaked into the room and cuddled up on little Moolii's belly. The weight started to sink Moolii into a never-ending nightmare...

The pet cats and dogs, the animal crossing the forest, they all start chasing Moolii and shoot dangerous stuff on her! Can Moolii escape her levels and levels of nightmare with the help of the mysterious Ferret?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280380/
[h3]Join Moolii's Dreamland Discord[url=https://discord.gg/apnWCWGYsu]Discord[/url]to explore more about the story![/h3]
